summary: Operator confirmed strict architectural requirement: Jarvis server must be stateless/disposable, with only Jarvis-level agent instructions allowed on its filesystem. No server code/config/migration/deployment changed. Previous work queues reviews WQ04/WQ05 ChangesRequested and WQ03 UUID journal ChangesRequested remain separate.
